_readme: Copy for the notes pages and the home section. Posts live one per file in config/notes/<slug>.json, where the file name becomes the URL (/notes/<slug>). Copy config/notes/_template.json to start a post; files whose name starts with "_" are skipped, and so is any post with "draft": true. Posts show newest first by `date`. The home section shows the newest `latestCount` posts, and the home section and the nav link hide themselves until at least one post is published.
